# AI Happy Design — Full Command Reference

Auto-generated from CLI schemas. Use `ahd-figma schema <command> --json` for machine-readable format.

## design.compute_tokens

Compute responsive design tokens for a target canvas

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| width | number | yes |  | >= 1 | Canvas width in pixels |
| height | number | yes |  | >= 1 | Canvas height in pixels |
| dpi | number |  |  |  | Optional DPI. Defaults to 72 for screen work. |

## tokens.export

Export a deterministic token preset or computed token snapshot

Aliases: `tokens.export_json`, `tokens.export_css`, `tokens.export_tailwind`, `tokens.export_swift`, `tokens.export_android`

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| preset | string |  |  | minimal/shadcn/tailwind/from_canvas | Token preset name |
| format | string |  |  | json/css/tailwind/swift/android | Output format |
| outputPath | string |  |  |  | Optional file path to write |
| configPath | string |  |  |  | Optional JSON config with outputs map |
| variablesFile | string |  |  |  | JSON file from variable.get_all |
| variables | array |  |  |  | Inline variable.get_all variables array |
| outputs | object |  |  |  | Format to output path map |

## parity.compare_code

Compare a code-spec JSON contract for semantic completeness before design-code parity checks

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| specPath | string |  |  |  | Path to a code-spec JSON file |
| codeSpecPath | string |  |  |  | Alias for specPath |
| codeSpec | object |  |  |  | Inline code-spec object |
| threshold | number |  |  |  | Minimum passing parity score |

## effect.add_shadow

Add a drop shadow to a node

Aliases: `shadow`

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| nodeId | string | yes |  | pattern: ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ |  |
| color | string |  | #00000040 | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Shadow color hex |
| offsetX | number |  | 0 |  | Horizontal offset |
| offsetY | number |  | 4 |  | Vertical offset |
| radius | number |  | 4 | 0-200 | Blur radius |
| spread | number |  | 0 | -100-100 | Spread distance |
| type | string |  | DROP_SHADOW | DROP_SHADOW/INNER_SHADOW |  |

## node.create_frame

Create a frame (Figma's equivalent of a div)

Aliases: `frame`

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| name | string |  |  |  | Semantic name for the frame (never leave as default) |
| parentId | string |  |  | pattern: ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ | Parent node ID (alias: pid) |
| x | number |  |  |  | X position |
| y | number |  |  |  | Y position |
| width | number |  |  | 1-10000 | Frame width (alias: w) |
| height | number |  |  | 1-10000 | Frame height (alias: h) |
| color | string |  |  | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Fill color hex (NOT fillColor) (alias: bg) |
| cornerRadius | number |  |  | 0-500 | Corner radius (alias: r) |
| opacity | number |  |  | 0-1 | Opacity |
| layoutMode | string |  |  | HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL | Auto-layout direction |
| itemSpacing | number |  |  | 0-500 | Spacing between auto-layout children |
| padding | number |  |  | 0-500 | Uniform padding for all sides |
| paddingTop | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| paddingRight | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| paddingBottom | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| paddingLeft | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| primaryAxisAlignItems | string |  |  | MIN/CENTER/MAX/SPACE_BETWEEN |  |
| counterAxisAlignItems | string |  |  | MIN/CENTER/MAX/BASELINE |  |
| layoutSizingHorizontal | string |  |  | FIXED/HUG/FILL |  |
| layoutSizingVertical | string |  |  | FIXED/HUG/FILL |  |
| layoutWrap | string |  |  | WRAP/NO_WRAP |  |
| clipsContent | boolean |  |  |  | Whether children clip to frame bounds |
| structural | boolean |  |  |  | Structural frame: removes default fill, enables clipping. Use for wrappers and auto-layout containers. |
| stroke | string |  |  | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Stroke color hex |
| strokeWeight | number |  |  | 0-100 |  (alias: sw) |
| minWidth | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Minimum width (auto-layout children only) |
| maxWidth | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Maximum width (auto-layout children only) |
| minHeight | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Minimum height (auto-layout children only) |
| maxHeight | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Maximum height (auto-layout children only) |

| y | number |  |  |  |  |

| fontFamily | string |  | Inter |  | Font family name (alias: ff) |
| fontStyle | string |  | Regular | Thin/Extra Light/ExtraLight/Light/Regular/Medium/Semi Bold/SemiBold/Bold/Extra Bold/ExtraBold/Black/Italic/Bold Italic | Font style (alias: fs) |
| color | string |  | #000000 | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Text color hex |
| lineHeight | number |  |  | 50-300 | Line height percentage (e.g. 150 = 150%%) (alias: lh) |
| lineHeightUnit | string |  |  | PIXELS/PERCENT/AUTO |  |
| letterSpacing | number |  |  | -5-20 |  (alias: ls) |
| width | number |  |  | 1-10000 | Text box width (enables wrapping) |
| textAlign | string |  |  | LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT/JUSTIFIED |  (alias: textAlignHorizontal) |
| textCase | string |  |  | ORIGINAL/UPPER/LOWER/TITLE |  |
| textDecoration | string |  |  | NONE/UNDERLINE/STRIKETHROUGH |  |
| maxLines | number |  |  | 1-100 | Maximum lines before truncation with ellipsis |
| layoutSizingHorizontal | string |  |  | FIXED/HUG/FILL |  |
| layoutSizingVertical | string |  |  | FIXED/HUG/FILL |  |
